title: RC wing
description: A built-up balsa wing from NACA digits, span, chords, sweep and washout: ribs with spar slots, leading and trailing edge stock, a plywood joiner, film on one panel. Cut sheet: export the face set "Cut sheet" with File > Export... to SVG or DXF, or file.export {set: "Cut sheet", width: "600 mm"}; it holds every rib of both panels, at true size. The sketch "Joiner flat pattern" holds the two V-shaped ply joiners, ready for the laser: select it and export DXF, or file.export {sketch: "Joiner flat pattern"}. Spars and edge stock are lengths in the outputs.
